modelAnswer:
When Mr. and Mrs. Green got home, Kevin went to talk to them. He told them everything, including the man’s words about his father’s watch. “He kept trying to lift a floorboard,” Kevin added. Mr. Green thought for a moment. “Let’s go and see.” Kevin led him to the board the man had touched, and Mr. Green pulled it up carefully. Under it lay a dusty box with an old silver watch inside.

Kevin and Mr. Green took the watch they had found to the police station. Before seeing it, the man was asked to describe it. “Silver, with a crack across the glass,” he said. It matched exactly. Holding the watch tightly, he said quietly, “My father hid it there before we moved.” Since nothing had been taken, Mr. Green asked the police to let him go. “Sorry, kid. I should have knocked on the door,” the man told Kevin. Kevin smiled with relief. Walking back to Mrs. Hill’s house, he decided he had had enough excitement for one day.
